name: Tian Feng
title: The Precious Talent of Hebei

skills.name: Deathly Counsel
skills.text: When you lose your last on-hand card, you can discard 1 card from another player.

skills.name: With the Tide
skills.text: When another player goes into brink of death, if the source of damage that caused it is from the same Kingdom as you are, draw 1 card from the deck. When a player from the same Kingdom as you dies, you lose 1 unit of health.

differenceFromNormal: He is a brand new character specially created for Kingdom Wars.
